definitions.gloss: partner; sidekick; the person one always teams up with
definitions.explanation: The colleague, teammate, or accomplice you regularly work alongside and trust. Warmer and more informal than パートナー, and it implies a pair rather than a group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相棒|あいぼう}だ。
examples.english: He's my partner of many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相棒|あいぼう}だ。
examples.english: He and I have been a pair since high school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{相棒|あいぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In detective dramas, two people with clashing personalities often end up as partners.

notes:
Originally the other person carrying a palanquin pole — literally "the one on the matching pole."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相棒|あいぼう}: longtime partner
- {相棒|あいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to pair up with someone
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{相棒|あいぼう}: a good partner
- {相棒|あいぼう}⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧: the two partners together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: companion, member of a group — not limited to two people
- ⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧: colleague — a workplace relation with no warmth implied
- ⟦パートナー→パートナー：11287_paatonaa⟧: partner — neutral and businesslike; also used for a spouse

Also used affectionately of a favourite object one works with daily, such as a well-worn tool or a bicycle.
